# no-examples-in-scenarios

Disallow Examples under a Scenario keyword instead of a Scenario Outline keyword.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| structure | no | no | none |

Finds Examples under the `Scenario` keyword instead of `Scenario Outline`.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-examples-in-scenarios": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Scenario: with Examples
```
